texts.initialStepDescription: On the first scan, the initialization memory is false: the initial steps are activated.
texts.initLatchDescription: The initialization memory latches: activation happens only once.
texts.crossingDescription: All conditions are computed before any evolution (rule 4).
texts.deactivationDescription: The upstream steps of the crossed transition are deactivated.
texts.activationDescription: The downstream steps of the crossed transition are activated: activation wins (rule 5).
texts.outputDescription: Continuous action: true while any of the steps that drive it is active.
